expectedIssues: Section title shows the raw translation key home_feed.popular_title instead of translated text
reportedIssues: The section heading displays the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated, human-readable title (e.g. 'Popular near you'). This indicates a missing or failed localization string.

The horizontal restaurant carousel under 'Fastest near you' cuts off the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right edge with no visual affordance (e.g. fade or partial-card hint is present but the title is truncated awkwardly).
The notification bell icon in the top-right has a red dot indicator but no visible label or badge count, which may be unclear to screen-reader users.
